messages:
Sam B: After the PM, we need a concrete eval/action plan for the recurring memory-pressure regression. Who can pick promptsets, load profiles, and CI gating?
Riya K: I'll own promptsets. plan: pull 30 incident sessions, make deterministic bundle mempress-v1. ETA 4d.
Tomas L: I'll add two load profiles: burst_95_60s and slow_soak_30m. will add k6 scripts and simulator configs. ETA 3d.
sre-bot: Postmortem PM-567 uploaded: https://files.redwood/pm/567.pdf
Sam B: CI gating: add `ci/evals/mempress-smoke` on canary and `ci/evals/mempress-full` nightly. if smoke fails, block canary.
Riya K: promptset stored in repo + tag, metadata includes incident id and expected tokens.
Tomas L: also suggest a focused chaos drill 2025-03-14 to validate fallback path (cache warm/cold). volunteers?
Sam B: volunteers: Riya (prompts), Tomas (load), Sam (runbook + rollback criteria). prep sync 2025-03-10.
Sam B: Action items:
- Riya K: mempress-v1 prompt bundle (ETA 2025-03-02)
- Tomas L: k6 profiles + sim configs (ETA 2025-03-01)
- Sam B: CI gating PR + runbook (ETA 2025-03-03)
Sam B: I'll open GH issue and add subtasks + owners. escalate here if any slip >48h.
Riya K: ack.
Tomas L: ack.
